votes.motion: forward a recommendation of DENIAL of Application PLZ-24-6001, adopting the Development Agreement for 2682 West 13400 South, thus keeping the existing R-2 Single Family Zoning. Commissioner Cluff

APPROVE Application PLZ-24-8012, My Storage Riverton Final Site Plan and Conditional Use Permit subject to the following conditions: 1. The Site Plan and Building Architecture may be amended as shown. 2. The rooftop mechanical must be screened. 3. All other Site Plan Improvements shall be consistent with the plans previously approved by the Planning Commission. Commissioner Cannon

APPROVE Application PLZ-24-2030, Myers Park Phase 2 Private Lane subject to the following conditions: 1. The private lane shall follow Riverton City Code for development on private lanes. 2. Approval is for a private lane, with up to fourteen (14) lots accessing the private lane. 3. The private lane shall match the width and design of the adjoining Myers Park with at least 32-foor paved surface and signed with “No Parking” as required by Fire Code. 4. The private lane shall be paved in either asphalt or concrete according to the requirements of the Unified Fire Authority and the Riverton City
APPROVE the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes of September 12, 2024, as reported. Commissioner Beck
